claims: Official OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP preserves the root and provider child as two canonical spans
Default root promotion selects the finalized root-linked application content even when the provider span contains an older draft
Explicit child promotion remains scoped to the latest selected child content
Model and application-version provenance still come from the selected OTLP span and resource
isolation: Dedicated /tmp corpus, synthetic evidence-provider content, localhost only, no production services, customer records, external models, or message delivery
limitations: Local OTLP receiver and promotion API only; no production deployment or external collector
